root_cause: blog/index.html contained a literal backslash-n immediately after the artikelen container marker while the deterministic publisher only recognized a real newline, causing Blogindex mist artikelen-marker.
prevention_rule: The approved blog publisher must recognize both the canonical real-newline marker and the historical literal backslash-n marker, normalize the latter, and fail closed when neither marker exists.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 37026137254 failed at Seal or render exact approved article with Blogindex mist artikelen-marker.
